changeSet.sql: -- Demo Tenant gets every lookup value UPDATE lookup_value SET tenant_id = 100; -- All other tenants get the lookup values that are in the tenant_lookup_value table INSERT INTO lookup_value (lookup_type_id, lookup_display, lookup_value, sort_seq, lookup_value_active, parent_lookup_value_id, tenant_id) SELECT lv.lookup_type_id, lv.lookup_display, lv.lookup_value, lv.sort_seq, lv.lookup_value_active, lv.parent_lookup_value_id, tlv.tenant_id FROM tenant_lookup_value tlv JOIN lookup_value lv ON tlv.lookup_value_id = lv.lookup_value_id WHERE tlv.tenant_id = (Select tenant_id from v_tenant t where t.name = 'Demo Tenant'); INSERT INTO lookup_value (lookup_type_id, lookup_display, lookup_value, sort_seq, lookup_value_active, parent_lookup_value_id, tenant_id) SELECT lv.lookup_type_id, lv.lookup_display, lv.lookup_value, lv.sort_seq, lv.lookup_value_active, lv.parent_lookup_value_id, tlv.tenant_id FROM tenant_lookup_value tlv JOIN lookup_value lv ON tlv.lookup_value_id = lv.lookup_value_id WHERE tlv.tenant_id = (Select tenant_id from v_tenant t where t.name = 'Endeavor');
